head: f8e7116
decision: The smallest acceptance-honest ownership floor cannot be implemented as one bounded R0 unit from current written contracts. Keep AT-hermes-config-69 and AT-activity-focus-86 pending. This is missing source/interface work, not an external blocker.

acceptanceBindings.sourceAssertion: - **AT-hermes-config-69 [R0]** Given the amended cadence registry and generated contracts, When schema/role cutover validation runs, Then `toy_si.cadence_slot`, `toy_si.run`, and `toy_si.review` have one Durable admission/Turn Review owner, Obligations reads a read-only projection, all canonical states including swept agree, and duplicate writers or noncanonical slot enums fail the gate.

- **AT-activity-focus-86 [R0]** Given amended generated cadence contracts, When the pre-build schema/caller gate exercises Activity-Focus and Obligations projections, Then only Durable admission/Turn Review writes `toy_si.cadence_slot`, `toy_si.run`, and `toy_si.review`, projection writes and alternative owners fail, and swept is distinct from accepted AI-reviewed coverage.

exactWrittenInterfaces.runAdmission: Self-Improvement §2 writes RunAdmission.admit(input: AdmissionInput): Promise<Result<RunRef>>, heartbeat(run: RunRef, leaseEpoch: Revision): Promise<Result<void>>, and terminal(run: RunRef, leaseEpoch: Revision, terminal: TerminalRecord): Promise<Result<void>>.
exactWrittenInterfaces.turnReview: Self-Improvement §3 writes TurnReview.checkStop(run: RunRef), review(run: RunRef), and get(runId: UUID), each returning Promise<Result<ReviewResult>>. ReviewResult is reviewed with an immutable Review or pending with an explicit reason and retry time.
exactWrittenInterfaces.missingInputContracts: AdmissionInput and TerminalRecord are referenced by the written signatures but have no field definitions in the spec or generated @toy/contracts sources. RunRef/Review/ReviewResult are specified in prose but not generated in the current contract inventory.
exactWrittenInterfaces.cadenceRow: Self-Improvement §5.2 gives the cadence_slot columns and key. No generated CadenceSlot DTO exists; current generated cadence contracts are CadenceSlotState, CadencePeriodV1, and CadenceCoverageV1.
exactWrittenInterfaces.obligationsProjection: Obligations §13.6 mandates a read-only slot projection but supplies no public method signature or result DTO. Write this owner interface before implementing callers; no method name is invented here.
exactWrittenInterfaces.databaseRoleMap: CONTRACTS names OS service identities such as _toy_pg and _toy_review, but does not map Durable admission/Turn Review and the Obligations projection to PostgreSQL roles or grants. Do not assume OS account names are PostgreSQL role names.

currentOwnerBoundary.singleExistingDdl: packages/self-improvement/migrations/capacity-trial.sql and capacity-trial-migration.ts create toy_si.cadence_slot as part of the trial schema.
currentOwnerBoundary.directWrites: packages/self-improvement/src/capacity-trial.ts directly inserts the 3,360 scheduled trial rows and updates cadence_slot for deferrals and misses. Its public CapacityTrialJournal is not the specified RunAdmission/TurnReview boundary.
currentOwnerBoundary.missingOwners: packages/self-improvement/src/public.ts exports CapacityTrialJournal but no RunAdmission or TurnReview implementation. packages/obligations/src/public.ts exports only ModuleId and has no read-only projection.
currentOwnerBoundary.trialRoutingGap: CapacityTrialJournal.startArm/deferSlot/reconcileArm need to write slot rows, but the written RunAdmission/TurnReview signatures do not define a trial-slot operation, and AdmissionInput is undefined. Routing the current writes through an invented adapter method or a string owner label would not prove canonical ownership.
currentOwnerBoundary.manifestGap: The acceptance index contains both IDs and source hashes, but tests/registry.yaml has no authored manifests for either. This integration is parent-owned after Life45 and cadence workers stop.

components: Complete the generated @toy/contracts inputs and outputs for the already-written RunAdmission and TurnReview signatures, plus the canonical CadenceSlot projection DTO.
Write the Obligations projection method signature/result contract and a canonical PostgreSQL capability map for the Durable owner and read-only projection role.

Consolidate toy_si.run, toy_si.review, and toy_si.cadence_slot under one actual owner migration with primary/foreign keys, slot uniqueness, the exact twelve-state constraint, and effective PostgreSQL grants/revokes.
Implement real RunAdmission/TurnReview persistence for the slot/run/review paths needed by the migration. Do not add stub methods or call an owner solely because its name appears in a registry.

Route CapacityTrialJournal slot creation and state changes through those actual owner operations, or first write a canonical capacity-trial mapping into the owner contract. Preserve no accepted TurnReview evidence as pending/zero reviewed.
Then add the two CLI manifests and source-mutation probes; parent owns public.ts/registry/fixture/feature-map integration after Life45 releases those files.
smallestRequiredOwnershipFloor.boundedness: These pieces share DTOs, migration ownership, caller behavior, and database grants. Dropping any one leaves the current direct writer or unnamed projection in place, so a narrower unit cannot honestly pass either ownership AT. Implementing all together exceeds the requested single roughly two-hour source unit.
smallestRequiredOwnershipFloor.noWorkerAssignment: No cadence source files are assigned by this refinement. This avoids overlap with Life45's four files. Parent integration files remain parent-owned and must wait until Life45 and cadence mutators stop.

static: Compare generated CadenceSlotState, CadenceCoverage state keys, and the owner migration's SQL state constraint against the exact CONTRACTS enum.
Inspect actual table definitions and owner API write sites for toy_si.cadence_slot, toy_si.run, and toy_si.review; reject a second DDL/DML path and a writable Obligations projection.
Use fake OS source-tree copies to inject an Obligations writer, a projection write grant, and a missing/extra enum state; each mutation must fail the same public source gate.
stackAndDatabase: Use the registered R0 fake CLI stack and its existing private disposable PostgreSQL 17 fixture (`withAccountingFixture`); apply the real owner migration in that isolated database.

Create/use the PostgreSQL roles named by the canonical capability map. Through the owner APIs, verify permitted owner persistence. Under the Obligations projection role, verify SELECT/readback succeeds and direct INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE against cadence_slot/run/review fail with PostgreSQL permission errors.

Attempt the competing projection writer under its real role and verify denial. Record SQL result/readback and teardown evidence through probe.show; do not connect to the production database or activate the Hermes scheduler.
AT-hermes-config-69.reviewEvidence: With no trusted accepted review supplied, RunAdmission/TurnReview readback remains pending and AI-reviewed coverage is zero. A `swept` row stays distinct and cannot be converted to reviewed.

static: Run the same generated schema, actual migration/API caller, read-only projection, duplicate-writer, and enum mutation checks through the assigned CLI probe.
Use one required-AI projection fixture containing a swept slot and no accepted TurnReview record; assert zero accepted AI-reviewed coverage for it.
AT-activity-focus-86.database: The AT's source/schema/caller evidence does not itself establish installed PostgreSQL roles; retain that proof in AT-hermes-config-69's required stack evidence.

commandsAfterAllSourceMutatorsStop: toy stack up --release R0 --world registered --clock fake --model fake --request-id <uuid> --json

limits.sourceAdmission: PENDING_SOURCE_WORK. The current capacity-trial DDL/write path is not proof of the canonical Durable admission/Turn Review owner.
limits.AThermesConfig69: PENDING; its stack qualifier requires actual disposable PostgreSQL role read/write evidence, not a source label or a fake permission object.
limits.ATActivityFocus86: PENDING; source/schema/caller restrictions and swept versus accepted reviewed coverage remain unverified.
limits.reviewedCoverage: No accepted TurnReview evidence was fabricated or inferred. Until a current trusted review is accepted, reviewed coverage remains zero.
limits.execution: Read-only spec/source review only. No source edits, generated output, tests, builds, CLI, runtime, database, provider, credentials, or network operations. Parent requests remain outside this card and their status is not inferred.

scopeStatement: Plan-only refinement. No current source slice is admitted, and no acceptance evidence or whole-card PASS is claimed.
